children: Elevate Campuses Limited is an integrated education infrastructure platform focused on student accommodation and K-12 assets, operating across India and the United Arab Emirates. The company owns, operates and manages on-campus student accommodation across higher education institutions (HEIs) under the “Good Host Spaces” and “ScholarZ” brands, while its K-12 portfolio comprises two assets in Dubai. As of March 31, 2026, the Pre-Acquisition Group had capacity to cater to 80,255 students across 15 cities in India and one city in the UAE. Its portfolio comprised seven owned student accommodation campuses with 20,368 beds across six Indian cities, 14 managed student accommodation campuses with 55,487 beds, and two K-12 assets with a student capacity of 4,400. The company’s student accommodation offering extends beyond housing to dining, laundry, gyms, sports facilities, and security, retail and recreation services, creating an integrated campus environment for students.
